dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You built this tavern overnight? Impressive!

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: I was exaggerating when I said that, but I wasn't kidding about being a great sailor in the past.

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: I've passed through vast thunderstorms more wrathful than the Raiden Shogun, and I've pierced through glaciers steelier than the Tsaritsa's heart.

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: ...Nothing compared to being able to return safely to Sumeru and open this lively tavern! Hahaha!
